candidates.source_name: PISRS - Pravno-informacijski sistem Republike Slovenije (official publication platform for Uradni list RS since 1 March 2026)
candidates.why_relevant: PISRS is the consolidated legislation register of Slovenia and, per a transition notice on uradni-list.si citing Art. 33 ZoUL, has taken over official publication of the Uradni list RS as of 1 March 2026. It carries the legally authoritative text, publication date, entry-into-force and transposition dates for ZBan, ZPlaSSIED and ZPPDFT and all their novele. This is the single hardest-dated primary channel for the cell.
candidates.source_subtype: official legislation register / official gazette platform
candidates.legal_status: official state publication; reuse of legislative text generally unrestricted, attribution expected
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the documented PISRS developer API (see separate candidate) for structured pulls; fall back to scheduled HTML fetch of pregledPredpisa pages keyed by ZAKO ids. Track new 'novela' entries and their 'veljavnost/uporaba' date fields.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from Uradni list transition notice
queries_used: PISRS ZBan-3 prečiščeno besedilo zakon o bančništvu
podatki.gov.si Uradni list RS odprti podatki zbirka predpisi PISRS API
candidates.observed_blocker: Homepage returns a JavaScript-dependent shell to a plain fetcher (title only, no navigation). Deep pregledPredpisa URLs and the /api/ path appear to serve content. Treat as JS-rendered, not dead.

candidates.source_name: PISRS API za razvijalce (PISRS developer API / Swagger)
candidates.why_relevant: A documented public API over the Slovenian legislation register, with per-collection endpoints (e.g. /predpis/...) and, per search-result descriptions, daily refresh (typically by 07:00). This is the machine-readable route to statutory metadata, amendment chains and dates without scraping. Highest-leverage single technical asset in this cell.
candidates.access_status: public documentation page; authentication requirements NOT confirmed
candidates.legal_status: government open data; specific licence not yet confirmed (OPSI datasets from the same family are CC BY 4.0)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the Swagger/OpenAPI spec, enumerate collection endpoints, then run a nightly diff against a local store of predpis records for the ZBan / ZPlaSSIED / ZPPDFT families. Also pull /api/uradni-list/objava/{issue}.pdf for gazette issues.
queries_used: podatki.gov.si Uradni list RS odprti podatki zbirka predpisi PISRS API
candidates.observed_blocker: The navodila page rendered as title-only to a plain fetcher — JS-rendered documentation. Endpoint details above come from search-result snippets, not from a rendered read; verify with a browser-capable pass.

candidates.source_name: Uradni list Republike Slovenije - official gazette (archive + current issues)
candidates.why_relevant: The historic and (pre-March-2026) authoritative gazette of record. Every banking/payments/AML statute and amendment has a stable per-act page with issue number, publication date and the act's own entry-into-force article. Even post-transition it remains the archival corpus back to the 1990s and the canonical citation form (Uradni list RS, št. 7/18, 102/20, 113/24, 17/25 for ZPlaSSIED).
candidates.access_status: public web pages free; PDF uredbeni/razglasni del linked per issue; some added-value services paywalled
candidates.legal_status: state official publication; archival status flagged under Art. 33 ZoUL after 1 Mar 2026
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the per-issue 'vsebina' index pages (stable pattern /glasilo-uradni-list-rs/vsebina/{year}-01-{seq}) and filter titles on the local-language act-name glossary; archive the linked uredbeni-del PDFs.
queries_used: Uradni list RS zakon o plačilnih storitvah, storitvah izdajanja elektronskega denarja in plačilnih sistemih novela
Urad za preprečevanje pranja denarja ZPPDFT-2 novela Uradni list predlog zakona

candidates.source_name: UL info tok / Uradni list e-bilten (legislative-change notification service)
candidates.why_relevant: The gazette publisher's own alerting layer: 'obveščanje o zakonodajnih novostih', newsletter and e-bilten news items that editorially flag what changed and when it applies. Useful as a low-cost tripwire that a new banking/AML/payments act has been published, and its plain-language notes explain effect dates.
candidates.access_status: partly free (news items, newsletter signup); UL info tok is a commercial subscription with free trial
candidates.legal_status: commercial publisher content; editorial text is copyrighted - summarise, do not republish
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe the newsletter to a monitored mailbox; poll the /novice and /e-bilten/novica pages for new items. Do not mirror editorial text.
queries_used: Urad za preprečevanje pranja denarja ZPPDFT-2 novela Uradni list predlog zakona

candidates.source_name: Državni zbor RS - Predlogi zakonov (bills under consideration)
candidates.why_relevant: The parliamentary pipeline: every bill in procedure with its EPA number, proposer, procedure type (redni / skrajšani / nujni postopek) and the full document trail. This is the earliest hard-dated adoption signal after ministry consultation, and the procedure type is itself a strong timing indicator (nujni postopek = weeks, not months).
candidates.access_status: public web portal (WebSphere portal, heavy URL encoding)
candidates.legal_status: public parliamentary record
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the OPSI XML dump (next candidate) over scraping this portal; use the HTML only to resolve individual EPA document pages.
queries_used: Državni zbor RS zakonodajni postopek predlogi zakonov iskalnik EPA finance
dz-rs.si zakonodaja predlogi zakonov v obravnavi Državni zbor spletna stran

candidates.source_name: OPSI open-data dataset: Državni zbor - Predlogi zakonov (PZ.XML)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable dump of all bills currently in parliamentary procedure plus adopted laws not yet published in the gazette, with an XSD schema and a CKAN metadata API. Publisher is the National Assembly itself; last updated 2 June 2026, originally added March 2018. Licence CC BY 4.0. This is the cleanest structured feed for A3 deadline tracking in the whole cell.
candidates.legal_status: CC BY 4.0 (Priznanje avtorstva) - reuse permitted with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Nightly GET of https://fotogalerija.dz-rs.si/datoteke/opendata/PZ.XML, validate against the XSD, diff against prior snapshot, filter on the sl glossary (bančništv*, plačiln*, elektronskega denarja, pranja denarja) and on proposer = Vlada RS / Ministrstvo za finance. Use the CKAN endpoint /api/3/action/package_show?id=dzpredlogi-zakonov to detect metadata refreshes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from DZ portal search results
queries_used: dz-rs.si zakonodaja predlogi zakonov v obravnavi Državni zbor spletna stran

candidates.source_name: Državni zbor RS - Prečiščena besedila zakonov (parliament-issued consolidated texts)
candidates.why_relevant: Parliament publishes official consolidated texts (UPB) after amendment waves. The appearance of a new ZBan or ZPlaSSIED UPB is itself a signal that the amendment cycle has closed, and gives a clean single text to diff against the prior consolidation.
candidates.legal_status: public parliamentary record
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic index crawl; alert on new UPB entries matching the act glossary. Cross-check against the PISRS consolidated text for the same act.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from DZ portal search results
queries_used: dz-rs.si zakonodaja predlogi zakonov v obravnavi Državni zbor spletna stran

candidates.source_name: e-Demokracija - Predlogi predpisov (national public-consultation portal, eUprava)
candidates.why_relevant: The mandatory pre-parliamentary public consultation stage. Draft texts appear here with the consulting ministry, a comment deadline, and lifecycle status (V pripravi / Predlog / Sprejet), filterable by ministry (Ministrstvo za finance) and subject area, plus a 'only commentable' filter. Confirmed use for banking/payments drafts: the Ministry of Finance ran the ZDUPS (accessibility and use of payment means) consultation and a central credit register reporting-scope draft (public consultation 4 Apr - 5 May 2025) here. Earliest hard-dated signal in the cell.
candidates.access_status: public, free; commenting requires participation but reading does not
candidates.legal_status: government portal; draft texts are public documents
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the filtered listing for organ = Ministrstvo za finance on a daily cadence; resolve each item via the stable detail pattern predlog-predpisa.html?id={numeric} and capture title, ministry, status, comment deadline and attached draft PDFs. Extract the 'rok za komentarje' date as the hard deadline field.
queries_used: e-Demokracija predpisi v pripravi Ministrstvo za finance javna obravnava predlog zakona banke

candidates.source_name: Ministrstvo za finance (GOV.SI) - news RSS and ministry pages
candidates.why_relevant: The sponsoring ministry for ZBan, ZPlaSSIED and (with the Office for Money Laundering Prevention) ZPPDFT. Its GOV.SI news RSS (orgID 24) announces the opening of public consultations, adoption of bills by the government, and outcome summaries of consultations - e.g. the 7 Apr 2025 announcement of a draft-law consultation and the list of respondents (Banka Slovenije, ZBS, KPK, ANR, GZS, Informacijski pooblaščenec). A ready-made RSS feed is a rare gift in this landscape.
candidates.legal_status: government public information
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to the RSS with orgID filter for Ministrstvo za finance; keyword-filter on the sl glossary and link out to the referenced e-Demokracija or DZ items.
queries_used: e-Demokracija predpisi v pripravi Ministrstvo za finance javna obravnava predlog zakona banke
"gov.si" Ministrstvo za finance "predpisi v pripravi" finančni sistem bančništvo

candidates.source_name: Vladna gradiva - government session materials (gradiva.vlada.si / vrs-3.vlada.si)
candidates.why_relevant: The dossier a ministry submits to the Government before a bill reaches parliament: the full explanatory memorandum, the EVA/IPP file numbers, the consultation report naming who commented and what changed, and the intended entry-into-force. Retrieved documents in this run (e.g. an IPP-numbered PDF on the central credit register draft) show the memoranda are directly downloadable. This is the richest 'why and when' layer behind the statutory dates.
candidates.access_status: public, but a legacy Domino-style repository with opaque GUID URLs and per-mandate silos (mandat20, mandat22)
candidates.legal_status: public government documents
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not attempt a full crawl. Resolve documents by EVA/IPP number harvested from e-Demokracija and DZ items; site-scoped search engine queries on vlada.si for the act glossary work well as an entry point. Archive PDFs/DOCs locally since GUID URLs rot across mandates.
queries_used: e-Demokracija predpisi v pripravi Ministrstvo za finance javna obravnava predlog zakona banke
"gov.si" Ministrstvo za finance "predpisi v pripravi" finančni sistem bančništvo
candidates.observed_blocker: Legacy .NSF URL structure and per-mandate paths; some documents served as .doc. Link rot across mandates is the main risk, not access control.

candidates.source_name: Državni svet RS (National Council) - sessions, opinions and suspensive veto
candidates.why_relevant: The second chamber can impose a suspensive veto (odložilni veto) that forces a re-vote in the National Assembly and pushes entry-into-force back by weeks. It has done so on banking legislation before (the 2013 banking act and the 2019 act on judicial protection of former holders of qualified bank liabilities). Its committee opinions carry EPA numbers, letting them be joined to the DZ pipeline. This is the main source of schedule risk that a gazette-only feed would miss.
candidates.access_status: public; opinions published as PDFs under /sites/default/files/
candidates.legal_status: public parliamentary record
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the session agendas and committee-opinion PDF directory; match EPA numbers against the DZ PZ.XML feed and raise a flag when a banking/payments/AML EPA gets an 'odložilni veto' item.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles actor mapping (who can delay entry into force) + search
queries_used: Državni svet RS veto zakon o bančništvu obravnava seja gradivo

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Plačilne storitve in storitve izdajanja elektronskega denarja (supervisor's legal-basis page)
candidates.why_relevant: The competent authority's own restatement of the ZPlaSSIED legal framework and the subordinate acts (sklepi) it issues under it. Useful as a cross-check on which version of the statute is operative and as the bridge from primary law to supervisory implementing acts, which are themselves published in the gazette. Adjacent to another coverage cell but load-bearing for confirming statutory citations.
candidates.legal_status: public authority information
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic fetch of the sl and en versions of the legal-framework pages; diff the cited gazette references to catch consolidations.
queries_used: Uradni list RS zakon o plačilnih storitvah, storitvah izdajanja elektronskega denarja in plačilnih sistemih novela

candidates.source_name: Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja (Office for Money Laundering Prevention)
candidates.why_relevant: The ZPPDFT owner. ZPPDFT-2 was adopted 23 Mar 2022 and entered into force 22 Nov 2022; the chain has since run through ZPPDFT-2C (2025) and ZPPDFT-2D (published in the gazette 23 Jul 2026, in force 7 Aug 2026), largely on beneficial-ownership register access. The Office issues the guidance and instructions that put dates on obliged-entity compliance work.
candidates.legal_status: government public information
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the office's GOV.SI subsite pages and its GOV.SI news RSS by orgID; join to gazette ZPPDFT entries for authoritative dates.
queries_used: Urad za preprečevanje pranja denarja ZPPDFT-2 novela Uradni list predlog zakona
candidates.observed_blocker: The exact GOV.SI path for the office was inferred from the standard organi-v-sestavi URL scheme, not read directly this run - treat the URL as unverified.

candidates.source_name: Tax-Fin-Lex - Slovenian tax, finance and law database
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial legal database with a per-act 'časovnica' (timeline) view of every ZBan / ZPlaSSIED / ZPPDFT version and the gazette reference behind each. It surfaces the amendment chain far faster than reconstructing it from the gazette, and its free preview pages are frequently the top search hit for a given act. Best used as a pointer to verify against PISRS, never as the authority.
candidates.access_status: freemium - document stubs and metadata visible, full texts behind subscription
candidates.legal_status: commercial, copyrighted editorial layer; ToS restrict systematic extraction
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/analyst lookup only. Do not bulk-scrape; use it to resolve an act's version history, then pull the authoritative text from PISRS or the gazette.

Valuable as an independent, English-language description of which Slovenian database is authoritative and how it is queried - exactly the kind of pointer that stays correct across the 2026 Uradni list to PISRS migration.

Running its CKAN search over the local-language glossary is the cheapest way to find further structured legislative feeds instead of scraping portals.

candidates.why_relevant: The open-data manifestation of the legislation register - basic metadata for all Slovenian regulations, including collections such as invalid/lapsed regulations and acts whose adoption procedure ended without adoption. That negative set is unusually valuable: it tells you which draft banking or payments acts died, which a gazette-only feed can never show.

candidates.why_relevant: English coverage of Slovenian primary banking legislation is thin and non-authoritative - the gazette publishes in Slovene. Tracked here only to record that the English route exists mainly through supervisor translations (Banka Slovenije en pages) and EU-level transposition notices, not through the gazette itself. Important for setting expectations on en-language collection.

negative_findings.description: uradni-list.si carries an explicit transition notice that, as of 1 March 2026, official publication moved to the Pravni informacijski sistem Republike Slovenije (PISRS), and that content shown on uradni-list.si is archival under Article 33 of the ZoUL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Any collector built against uradni-list.si URL patterns alone will silently stop seeing newly published acts after Mar 2026. The authoritative feed for anything published after that date is PISRS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the single largest structural break in the cell. A pipeline anchored on the old gazette would fail open - it would keep returning 200s on archived pages while missing every new statutory deadline.

negative_findings.description: Both pisrs.si (homepage) and pisrs.si/swagger/navodila returned title-only content to a plain markdown-converting fetcher, indicating client-side rendering.
negative_findings.result_summary: No navigation, endpoint list or terms could be read directly. Endpoint hints (/predpis/..., daily refresh by ~07:00, /api/uradni-list/objava/{issue}.pdf) come from search-result snippets only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most important source in the cell is the one hardest to read with a simple fetcher. A browser-capable or API-first collection pass is required before this source can be relied on. This is a hypothesis about rendering, NOT a finding that the site is unavailable.

negative_findings.description: No RSS or Atom feed was identified for the e-Demokracija predlogi predpisov listing, despite it being the earliest-signal consultation source in the cell.
negative_findings.result_summary: The rendered listing exposes ministry/type/subject filters and a 'commentable only' toggle, but no feed URL surfaced in the page content read.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Consultation deadlines will have to be captured by polling and diffing HTML rather than by subscribing, which raises maintenance cost and the risk of missing a short comment window.

negative_findings.description: Government session materials live on a legacy Lotus Domino repository split by parliamentary mandate (gradiva.vlada.si/mandat22/..., vrs-3.vlada.si/MANDAT20/...) with GUID-based paths and .doc/.pdf attachments.
negative_findings.result_summary: Documents are publicly reachable but the URLs are not predictable or durable across mandates.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Explanatory memoranda - which contain the intended entry-into-force and the consultation response summaries - cannot be systematically crawled and must be resolved via EVA/IPP numbers and archived immediately on discovery.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching ('Slovenia official gazette banking act amendment entry into force') surfaced no authoritative English channel for Slovenian primary banking legislation.
negative_findings.result_summary: All authoritative primary-law sources in this cell publish in Slovene only. English exists only as unofficial supervisor translations or EU-level transposition notices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that Slovene-language collection is not optional for workstream A3 in SI; an English-only pipeline would have near-zero recall on statutory deadlines.

negative_findings.description: The GOV.SI page for the Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja was constructed from the standard organi-v-sestavi URL scheme rather than read directly during this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: The office's existence and its ownership of ZPPDFT are well evidenced; the specific URL is inferred.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Per the hard rules this is recorded as unverified rather than asserted as live; the deterministic verification pass should resolve or correct it.

coverage_gaps.description: The PISRS developer API contract (endpoint inventory, auth model, rate limits, licence) was not actually read, only inferred from snippets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-capable fetch of https://pisrs.si/swagger/navodila and the underlying OpenAPI JSON, then document endpoints and terms before building any collector.

coverage_gaps.description: The Ustavno sodišče RS (Constitutional Court) was not scouted, yet it has repeatedly ruled on Slovenian banking legislation (e.g. the bail-in / qualified bank liabilities line of cases) and can suspend or annul statutory provisions, resetting deadlines.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add us-rs.si (odločbe and sklepi search, plus its published case register) as a candidate in a follow-up pass and join its decisions to gazette act identifiers.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level transposition tracking (EUR-Lex national transposition measures notified by Slovenia, and Commission infringement decisions for late transposition of PSD/EMD/AMLD instruments) was not covered in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add EUR-Lex NIM search filtered to SI and the Commission infringement database as pointer sources; late-transposition infringements are an early predictor of a rushed nujni postopek bill.

coverage_gaps.description: The act-name glossary built here covers ZBan-3/ZBan-3A, ZPlaSSIED (+ -A/-B novele), ZPPDFT-2 (+ -2C/-2D) and the draft ZDUPS, but not the adjacent statutes that carry payments-relevant deadlines: ZPlaSS predecessors, ZTFI-1 (market infrastructure), ZISDU, the resolution act (ZRPPB) and the central credit register act (ZCKR).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the sl glossary with ZRPPB, ZCKR, ZTFI-1 and their aliases before configuring keyword filters on PZ.XML and the gazette index, otherwise relevant bills will be filtered out.

coverage_gaps.description: Parliamentary committee level (Odbor za finance) agendas, magnetogrami and amendment texts were not scouted separately from the bills tracker.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the DZ committee pages and the Poročevalec DZ series; committee amendments are where entry-into-force dates most often shift late in the procedure.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank/industry consultation respondents were identified by name (Združenje bank Slovenije, GZS, KPK, ANR, Informacijski pooblaščenec) but their own published consultation submissions were not scouted as sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball ZBS (zbs-giz.si) and GZS position papers - they reveal industry-anticipated compliance dates and objections before the statute is fixed.

brief: Slovenia's primary-legislation channel for banking, payments and AML is unusually well instrumented but is mid-migration: uradni-list.si carries an explicit notice that official publication moved to PISRS on 1 March 2026 under Art. 33 ZoUL, so PISRS - and its documented developer API - is now the authoritative anchor while the old gazette remains the archive of record back to the 1990s. Upstream of publication, the pipeline is fully observable in Slovene: e-Demokracija exposes ministry drafts with hard comment deadlines (the Ministry of Finance ran the ZDUPS payment-means and central-credit-register consultations there), vladna gradiva carry the explanatory memoranda and consultation reports, and the National Assembly publishes every bill in procedure as a CC BY 4.0 XML dump (PZ.XML) that is the cleanest machine-readable deadline feed in the cell, with the Državni svet's suspensive veto as the main source of late schedule slippage. Everything authoritative is Slovene-only - English searching surfaced no official channel - so local-language collection is mandatory, with commercial aggregators (Tax-Fin-Lex, FinD-INFO) and free mirrors (racunovodstvo.net, zakonodaja.com) useful only as amendment-lineage pointers. The principal open risks are that PISRS renders client-side and its API contract was not directly read, and that the Constitutional Court and EU transposition-infringement channels remain unscouted.
